lessons.key: spec_deviation::boot time one shot scheduling calls against redis valkey e g registering a bullmq repeatable job should use a short lived connection with a timeout not the shared long lived singleton so a broker outage at boot cannot leave the singleton connection stuck retrying and block subsequent worker queue use
lessons.text: Boot-time one-shot scheduling calls against Redis/Valkey (e.g. registering a BullMQ repeatable job) should use a short-lived connection with a timeout, not the shared long-lived singleton, so a broker outage at boot cannot leave the singleton connection stuck retrying and block subsequent worker/queue use.
